targets.old_statement: Driving unsupervised at Level Two, a teen may carry only one passenger under 21 who does not live in the same household.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Driving unsupervised at Level Two, a teen may carry only one passenger under twenty-one who does not live in the same household.
targets.statement: When driving unsupervised at Level Two, a driver may carry one passenger under twenty-one from outside the household, plus one additional outside passenger under twenty-one who is a student being driven directly to or from school, while there is no under-twenty-one limit when all passengers live in the driver's household.

targets.old_statement: If every passenger lives in the driver's household there is no under-21 limit, but under-21 household members may not ride along while under-21 non-household passengers are aboard.
targets.old_spoken_statement: If every passenger lives in the driver's household there is no under-twenty-one limit, but under-twenty-one household members may not ride along while under-twenty-one non-household passengers are aboard.
targets.statement: When driving unsupervised at Level Two, there is no under-twenty-one passenger limit if every passenger lives in the driver's household, but under-twenty-one household members may not ride in the vehicle while under-twenty-one non-household members are aboard.
